A CONNECTED MANUFACTURING JOURNEY

From the first drawing
to the final assembly.

Bring us a complete project or a specific requirement. The stages below show how our services can connect; your agreed scope determines which are needed.

  1. 01

    Design

    Resolve the drawings, application and key requirements.

  2. 02

    Prototype

    Review an initial version before agreeing the production approach.

  3. 03

    Manufacture

    Coordinate fabrication and machining to the agreed specification.

  4. 04

    Finish

    Define surface preparation, coating and appearance requirements.

  5. 05

    Inspect

    Check the dimensions and agreed acceptance criteria.

  6. 06

    Assemble & dispatch

    Bring parts together and agree testing, packaging and dispatch.
